title: Implement sess_reset in wolfssl cipher providers (AES-CBC, AES-GCM)
description: wolfssl_aes_cbc.c: sess_reset calls wc_AesFree then wc_AesInit+wc_AesSetKey — requires adding u8 stored_key[32] and u32 stored_keylen to wolfssl_aes_cbc_ctx and populating in sess_init. Clear inbuf (krealloc to 0 or just reset inbuf_len). wolfssl_aes_gcm.c: same pattern — add stored_key/stored_keylen, reset with wc_AesFree+wc_AesInit+wc_AesGcmSetKey. Also clear AAD, tag, ivlen, processed, inbuf state. sess_free must zeroize stored_key. Both update ops struct with .sess_reset.
